children: Gigabroker is built on Huddlestock’s European Investment-as-a-Service platform and regulatory framework. It gives German retail investors access to stocks, ETFs, savings plans and crypto in one app. The platform operates under BaFin supervision. Huddlestock believes that Gigabroker, as a new player built on state-of-the-art technology, will be an attractive platform in the German market.

The platform core architecture is feature complete. In line with highest industry standards, Huddlestock and Gigabroker will use the coming weeks for final routine testing of stability and performance under load. Launching on all channels at the same time gives customers access to the full product offering from day one.

Gigabroker’s owner, AVL, already serves approximately 65,000 customers, who make up the initial addressable base at launch. Huddlestock earns revenue from the partnership based on trading activity on the platform.
Gigabroker’s ambition is to become one of the leading neobrokers in Germany, aiming to sustainably scale the platform to support over 200,000 customers within three years.

Huddlestock is a European Investment-as-a-Service provider enabling financial institutions and digital platforms to launch and scale investment services efficiently and in full regulatory compliance. Through its BaFin-regulated entity, Huddlestock GmbH, the company provides access to a comprehensive liability umbrella and European passporting framework, allowing partners to offer regulated investment services without requiring their own financial license. Combining regulatory infrastructure with a modular, partner-based ecosystem, Huddlestock enables clients to build tailored investment solutions while significantly reducing time-to-market and operational complexity. Huddlestock Group also includes Visigon, a Nordic based consulting company with deep expertise in capital markets and treasury technology.

This information has been submitted pursuant to the Securities Trading Act § 5-12 and MAR. The information was submitted for publication, through the agency of the contact persons set out above, at 2026-10-27 17:20 CET.
